I will buy one bag of NPK fertilizer for this millet plot because the soil here is poor and without it the harvest is too small to feed the family. I also spread manure from our goats and cattle to keep the land strong. I sow seed saved from last season because improved seeds are expensive and difficult to find in our market. My children and I will do all the planting, weeding, and harvesting ourselves, so I do not need to pay for hired help.
